! Game text
| Deploy on table. Your [Separatist] droids are power +1 and may shuttle from battleground systems for free. During battle, may place this Effect out of play to cancel and redraw your just-drawn destiny. Once per turn, each player may ignore any deploy cost on [Virtual Block 4] [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough{{!}}Watch Your Step]] and once per game, while that Objective on table, you may ▲ a starfighter (or draw two cards from Reserve Deck). Jedi Tests may not modify your battle or weapon destiny draws. Lost if your [Virtual Block 4] objective on table. [Immune to [[Alter]]] || —

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Begin Landing Your Troops & The Dark Path]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Begin Landing Your Troops & The Dark Path (Errata)]] shares the [[Begin Landing Your Troops & The Dark Path]] column; [[Begin Landing Your Troops & The Dark Path (Errata 2)]] shares the [[Begin Landing Your Troops & The Dark Path]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
